display.purpose: Stat values like 7h 32m; sibling of the SVG gauge numeral (28 units in a 100-unit viewBox, 700).

title.purpose: The site placard, uppercase with the 2.25rem x 2px copper underline bar.

body.purpose: Prose, notices, buttons. Never uppercase, never mono.

label.purpose: Card headings, stat labels, chart titles, placards, version stamp. Status words use it at 0.22em/0.14em tracking with matching text-indent.

caption.purpose: Secondary UI: footer links, toggle buttons, back links.

shadows.name: panel-shadow
shadows.purpose: The single ambient shadow on every milled panel, paired with inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05).

motion.name: gauge-sweep
motion.purpose: The dial arc sweeping in, staggered 0/120/240ms across the cluster; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ui-state
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/press transitions on buttons, toggles, and links.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Calm opacity pulse on loading panels, never a shimmer sweep; frozen at 0.6 opacity under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Range Toggle

components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); background: #0b0c0e; } .ds-toggle-btn { border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: rgba(230, 233, 238, 0.66); font-family: 'B612 Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 400; padding: 0.65rem 1.05rem; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-toggle-btn:not(.ds-active):hover { color: #e8eaed; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-toggle-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-toggle-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0a066; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-toggle-btn.ds-active { background: rgba(224, 160, 102, 0.1); border-color: rgba(224, 160, 102, 0.35); color: #e0a066; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
This is a cockpit instrument for sleep, not a health-tech marketing surface. The whole page is a night-table readout viewed on a phone in a dim bedroom: a near-black graphite ground, milled panel surfaces with hairline bezels, and B612 — the typeface Airbus commissioned for cockpit displays — as the only voice. One burnished-copper lamp is the sole chrome accent; everything else speaks in the three metric identity hues or in quiet ink. The signature form is the 270° tick-gauge dial: an SVG tick ring, a flat track sweeping from 135°, a metric-colored arc, a mono numeral, and a status word resting in the dial's open bottom gap. With all content removed, the dials alone identify the world.

The system refuses both the category default (three equal stat cards above a stock chart block) and its opposite (glowing neon glassmorphism). It is dark-only by design — there is no light mode and no prefers-color-scheme branch — and nothing on the page is allowed to look like an alarm. Status at its worst is a muted terracotta word at instrument-lamp intensity, never a red number. Density is calm: a single 42rem column, generous panel spacing, one story per glance.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only graphite flight deck (#0b0c0e ground, #15171a panels), fixed 3% SVG grain texture
Hue encodes metric identity everywhere — copper readiness, dim-blue sleep, olive activity — in dials and charts alike
One copper chrome accent (#e0a066); status is a quiet word on an amber floor, never alarm red
B612 for prose, B612 Mono (tabular) for every number, label, and placard; both self-hosted under strict CSP
Milled surfaces: flat fills, hairline borders, one inset top highlight — no blur, no glow, no glass

rules.name: The Metric Identity Rule
rules.body: Hue encodes metric identity everywhere — readiness is copper, sleep is blue, activity is olive — in dials, chart lines, swatches, and tooltip rows alike. Score status is carried by a quiet word in the dial's bottom gap; it never recolors the numeral or the arc.

rules.name: The Amber Floor Rule
rules.body: No alarm red anywhere. The status ramp bottoms out at muted terracotta (#cf8771) at instrument-lamp intensity. A bad night reads as a dim lamp, not a siren.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Burnished copper is the only chrome accent. No second accent color may appear on chrome — buttons, focus, active states, and links all speak copper or stay neutral.

rules.name: The Mono Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number on the surface — gauge numerals, stat values, sync stamps, chart ticks, tooltips, the version stamp — is B612 Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: The --fs-* ramp (0.7 / 0.8 / 0.95 / 1.05 / 1.1 / 1.4rem) is the only set of font sizes on the surface. New text picks the nearest existing step.

rules.name: The Milled Surface Rule
rules.body: Every panel is the same recipe: flat fill, hairline bezel, one inset top highlight, one ambient shadow. No blur, no glow, no gradient fills — a milled surface, not glass.

dos: Do give every number B612 Mono with tabular numerals; keep prose in B612 and never mono.
Do carry metric identity by hue everywhere — readiness #e0a066, sleep #8fb0d4, activity #a3b47e — in dials, chart lines, keys, and tooltips alike.
Do render status as a quiet uppercase word at lamp intensity in the dial's bottom gap (The Amber Floor Rule).
Do build every new surface on the milled-panel recipe: #15171a fill, 1px bezel, inset top highlight, the one panel shadow, 16px radius.
Do keep the single 42rem column and the --sp-* / --fs-* ramps; self-host every font under the strict CSP (no external origins; all styles in styles.css).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the arc sweep, skeleton pulse, and press transforms while keeping feedback legible.
donts: Don't use alarm red anywhere; the status ramp bottoms out at #cf8771 (The Amber Floor Rule).
Don't add a second chrome accent; copper is the only lamp on chrome (The One Lamp Rule).
Don't recolor a numeral or arc by status — status is a word, never a floodlight.
Don't use blur, glassmorphism, neon glow, gradient fills on panels, or any light mode; the world is dark-only milled graphite.
Don't ship stock Chart.js chrome — no legend boxes, default tooltips, or default grid; restyle per the Charts spec.
Don't add inline styles, external stylesheets, or remote fonts; the CSP forbids them.
